text: The unauthorized CreateAccessKey attempt by leaked key AKIAJOGCDXJ5NW5PXUPA is recorded only in aws:cloudtrail iam.amazonaws.com AccessDenied events, with the target resource name carried solely in the errorMessage field (requestParameters is null in every denial event of the burst).

The target resource of the denied CreateAccessKey attempt is the literal string nullweb_admin, not web_admin: the CreateAccessKey event's own errorMessage and all three same-burst sibling key-management denials (ListAccessKeys x2, DeleteAccessKey) read 'user nullweb_admin', while the only 'user web_admin' reading comes from a GetUser denial 11 minutes later, from a different source IP and user agent, where GetUser with no parameters names the caller's own user.
evidence: Raw reads: CreateAccessKey errorMessage 'iam:CreateAccessKey on resource: user nullweb_admin'; ListAccessKeys x2 and DeleteAccessKey in the same burst read 'user nullweb_admin' identically; the only 'user web_admin' reading is the 09:27:07Z GetUser denial from 82.102.18.111/ElasticWolf, a different session, and GetUser-with-no-parameters names the caller itself. The CreateUser denial in the same burst targets arn:aws:iam::622676721278:user/my_db_user, a different act.
rival: web_admin (the GetUser denial's resource string and the calling identity's userName) and my_db_user (the CreateUser denial's target in the same burst)
